title: St. Philip's Church (Charleston, South Carolina)
geometryBasis: Native building way and mapped parts identify the projecting steeple and gabled nave. The National Park Service describes the curve around the tower on Church Street.
sectionBasis: The current Qualla photograph and federal heritage inventory establish a pale stucco church, classical porticoes and the stepped cream spire, with a visible clock, tiered belfry and thin upper needle.
limitations: The standing church, porticoes and steeple. Adjacent Good Shepherd Chapel, churchyard and interior lie outside scope.
The steeple uses the mapped height, and intermediate heights and ornament are estimated.
